## Summary

The tier list, exactly as placed (13 items, all identified; one item OCR missed, vision caught: methylene blue):

| Tier | Items (as labeled in the image) |
|---|---|
| S | Pristiq 50 mg (desvenlafaxine, ER) · Pramipexole 0.5 mg ("Pimapexole 0.5") |
| A | Dapoxetine HCl 30 mg (Extralast, Lupin) · Luvox 50 mg (fluvoxamine maleate, Abbott) |
| B | Full-spectrum Kanna tablets 50 mg (Nootropics Depot, 3% mesembrine) · Methylene Blue 15 mg (Rx vial) · Parnate 10 mg (tranylcypromine) |
| C | Cordyceps 250 mg (ND 10:1) · Provironum 25 mg (mesterolone) · Dura 5 (tadalafil 5 mg) · Testosterone propionate 100 mg/ml (Wells Pharmacy) |
| D | Magnesium glycinate (Solgar) · Adderall XR 30 mg (Shire) |

Reading of the ranking logic: S = the "increase drive but blunt the finish" combo (SNRI off-label delayed ejaculation + D2 agonist libido). A = serotonergic delay (fluvoxamine; dapoxetine is the one drug actually licensed for PE in many countries). B = a grab bag where two of three are MAO-A inhibitors (Parnate, methylene blue). C = erection-quality/androgen lane (tadalafil, mesterolone, testosterone) + cordyceps. D = the two items with the safest profiles (magnesium) and the "wrong tool" pick (stimulants).

## Why it matters

- Worth keeping strictly as a **map of the meme-pharmacology space** around stamina/PE — it names every drug class the manosphere tier-accounts circulate (SNRI, D2 agonist, SSRI, dapoxetine, MAOI, PDE5i, androgens) in one image. The one evidence-based, on-label item (dapoxetine) sits below the meme picks — typical of the format.
- **Skepticism gates, hard:** (1) meme ranking, zero evidence cited, author is an engagement-bait tier-list account (not a clinician — the handle is the joke). (2) **The image is not a stack and must not be read as one**: B-tier Parnate (tranylcypromine) and methylene blue are MAO-A inhibitors — combined with ANY serotonergic elsewhere in the same image (Pristiq, Luvox, dapoxetine) that's the classic serotonin-serotonin-serotonin syndrome / hypertensive-crisis contraindication. The tier placement actively buries this. (3) Prescription-only and/or controlled throughout (Adderall, testosterone, pramipexole, MAOIs); pramipexole carries impulse-control and sleep-attack liabilities; androgens suppress the HPG axis. (4) Bottom-tier magnesium glycinate is the only item with a benign profile — the format rewards drama, not safety.
- UAE posture: all Rx items prescription-controlled; the androgen entries (testosterone propionate, mesterolone) are the same gray-market vendor lane as the Driada catalog capture. Reference-only, no task — same checking-not-ordering posture as the rest of this thread.
